subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Somebody stole my favourite shoes.
solution:
The correct answer is '**My favorite shoes were stolen.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **Active Voice**.
 
• As per the question we have to change it into **Passive Voice**.
 
• The process of transformation as follows:
 
 
• We know that the **object "my favourite shoes**" will become the subject in the **passive voice** sentence.
 
• The structure of **passive voice** is:
 
 
• **Object of the Active Voice sentence + appropriate form of the verb 'to be' + past participle of the verb + by + subject of the Active Voice sentence (optional)**
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct **passive voice** sentence is:
 
 
• **"My favourite shoes were stolen."**
 
 

Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.
